title: Release lore-cli 0.13.1, paired with quest-cli 0.13.1, so the opum-lore plugin ships the gated Lore pane auto-start
description: Operator/leader instruction 2026-10-13 (team-lead, under opum-doc DEC-182): cut lore's half of the paired 0.13.1 release. LCLI-705 (opum-ai/lore-cli#556) gates the Lore pane's auto-start so it no longer opens in teammate sessions; it is on dev only, and main (19c88460) and tag v0.13.0 lack it. Ship dev as gated (f82bdfbd at filing). Both lore and quest are 0.13.0 on npm. quest-cli prepares its own 0.13.1 in parallel (constitution Article 3 clauses 1-2: one version, every release a pair). PROCEDURE: docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md plus docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md. This task's first slice is the bump PR; merge, promotion, tag push, rc staging, opum-cli-e2e qualification and the latest promotion each wait on the leader's word and publication/tag push are tier 3 (operator dialogs). Constraint found: the bump PR's docs gate and compile smoke need a quest carrying 0.13.1 (pair lock LCLI-650); neither npm nor quest-cli dev/main has it at filing, so ci.yml QUEST_SOURCE_REF must name a quest-cli commit reading 0.13.1 (DEC-55 fallback).

acceptanceCriteria.text: package.json, its optionalDependencies pins, all six npm/<platform>/package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json and bun.lock read 0.13.1
CHANGELOG.md carries a [0.13.1] section covering every change since 0.13.0, and README version lines are regenerated and pass shipped-readme-version --check
The three Ladybug digest baselines are refreshed, with only canonicalExportSha256 moved and the negative control run
CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.13.1 and ci.yml QUEST_SOURCE_REF names a verified quest-cli commit carrying 0.13.1 (or quest 0.13.1 is on npm)
version-parity and breaking-bump checks run against quest-cli, and the bump PR into dev is green
The pair is staged under release-candidate, qualified by opum-cli-e2e, and promoted to latest quest first then lore, each only on the leader word
Post-latest checklist done: marketplace handshake and Article 3 clause 7 announcements
